headline: AMBER — race done, now pure recovery; no session today
summary:
Valtellina Wine Trail is in the books (Nov 7, finished strong per the Chiuro file — 8:08 moving, 825m D+, feel 3/RPE 9). Since then you've logged two travel days of easy running plus a big Barcelona trail outing on the 11th (24.9km, 572m D+, RPE 7, feel 4/Poor) that pushed ATL up sharply. Today's wellness confirms you're still digesting that load: HRV 44 (down from 48 yesterday and well off the 10-day average of ~62), RHR 50 (above your typical 46-48), sleep only 5.8h. That's a clean AMBER — low-40s HRV plus short sleep, even though you've logged zero steps so far today (no activity yet). There's no prescribed session logged for today, so this is a true rest/recovery call, not a hard day to defend.</summary>
